name: generate-types
description: Generate frontend TypeScript types from Prisma schema models with camelCase conversion

preview.description: Preview generated types without writing file

documentation.overview: Reads Prisma schema and generates matching frontend TypeScript types. Complements /sync-types (which validates) — this skill GENERATES types.
keyFeatures: Parses Prisma schema to extract model fields and relations
Reads serializer RELATION_MAPPINGS for custom field name mappings
Converts all field names to camelCase (matching serializer output)
Generates: Entity, CreateRequest, UpdateRequest, QueryParams, PaginatedResponse interfaces
Preview mode to see output before writing
important: DateTime fields become 'string' (ISO format in frontend)
Relation fields are included as optional properties
Run /sync-types after generating to validate the output
